description: This dataset enhances its previous version by incorporating new data from the [Crossref November 2024 Dump](https://api.crossref.org/snapshots/monthly/2024/11), as well as the November 2024 dump of [JaLC (Japan Link Center)](https://japanlinkcenter.org/top/).
stats_note: 2,718,222 editors and 101,612,475 publishers (counted by roles, without disambiguating individuals)
